name: Static Semantic Human NeRF
definition: A neural network that co-learns a radiance field Fω for free-viewpoint rendering and a signed distance function Hˆ ω for 3D geometric reconstruction of a static human, using imGHUM as a geometric prior to regularize the opacity field and ensure accurate human geometry.
summary: Static Semantic Human NeRF is a neural rendering method that co-learns a radiance field and signed distance function to solve poor generalization in sparse human views by leveraging an implicit parametric model as a geometric prior.
